text: Drake Maye has shaken off an early-season slump to earn AFC Offensive Player of the Week honors after his three-touchdown performance lifted the Patriots to a stunning 29-26 victory over the Bills last Sunday—a comeback win that Mike Vrabel emphasized was critical for the defending AFC East champions as they sit at 2-2 and prepare for Sunday's home matchup against the Raiders at 1 PM ET. The personnel moves this week saw the Patriots release linebacker Jose Ramirez while adding cornerback Al'Zillion Hamilton to the practice squad and releasing offensive lineman Da'Metrius Weatherspoon, suggesting continued roster adjustments as New England looks ahead. The Patriots' defense neutralized Buffalo's Dalton Kincaid in Week 4, but Las Vegas presents a formidable challenge with two talented tight ends in Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer who loom as major threats in the passing game this Sunday.
